name: Gold Coast Motor Museum
reason: Rule 1-2: two Wikivoyage pages list it, 75 vehicles, ticketed ($24), a visit of an hour or more.
objection: A niche motoring shed in the hinterland; only for enthusiasts.

name: Australian Outback Spectacular
reason: Rule 4: a nightly dinner show, a recurring show rather than a place; sold by an operator.
objection: It is a permanent purpose-built venue and a Wikivoyage Do listing.

name: Beaudesert Historical Museum
reason: Rule 1-2: one Wikivoyage See listing for a small local museum; open hours limited; short visit.
objection: A volunteer-run local museum is the kind of stop a guide lists for Beaudesert and costs little.

name: Box Log Falls
reason: Rule 1/3: one Wikivoyage listing with no description; a minor falls on the Green Mountains circuits in Lamington.
objection: Named waterfall with a Wikipedia article, but only reached as part of the Box Forest circuit.

name: Broadbeach beach
reason: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage Do listing for patrolled beach; a beach is a second-tier stop that qualifies.
objection: One of many near-identical Gold Coast beaches.

name: Burleigh Beach
reason: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage See listing, surf and swimming beach under Norfolk pines; distinct from the headland.
objection: Close to Burleigh Head NP and just another Gold Coast beach.

name: Burleigh Head National Park
reason: Rule 1-3: Wikivoyage See listing; rainforest headland with walking circuit and lookouts; a half-day visit.
objection: Small urban park; its lookouts are part of it, so it is the one spot.

name: Chinatown
reason: Rule 1-2: one Wikivoyage See listing for two streets of Asian restaurants and shops in Southport; the draw is eating, not a sight.
objection: A named precinct with a Wikipedia article; but mostly shops and restaurants.

name: Coomera Falls
reason: Rule 1-3: Wikivoyage See listing, a 64 m segmented waterfall named by the park as one of its most visited falls.
objection: Needs a long Binna Burra walk; one counted source.

name: Cunninghams Gap
reason: Rule 1-3: Wikivoyage Boonah Do listing; historic pass in Main Range with lookouts and walks, but source is a narrative paragraph and one source.
objection: Famous Scenic Rim gap with a Wikipedia article; arguably a roadside crossing.

name: Currumbin Wildlife Sanctuary
reason: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage See listing; major wildlife park, full-day visit.
objection: Paid commercial attraction; but an obvious draw.

name: David Fleay Wildlife Park
reason: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage See listing; native wildlife park in Burleigh, a visit of 1-3 hours.
objection: Overlaps Currumbin as a wildlife park; still a distinct place.

name: Elabana Falls
reason: Rule 1-3: Wikivoyage names it as a falls reached from Green Mountains tracks; named among the park's most visited; one source.
objection: Part of the Box Forest and Toolona circuits, not a separate trip.

name: Federation Walk Coastal Reserve
reason: Rule 1-2: one Wikivoyage Do listing for a Main Beach coastal reserve walk; short visit.
objection: Pleasant coastal rainforest and wetland strip next to the Spit; low profile.

name: Freeman's Lookout
reason: Rule 1-2: one Wikivoyage lookout listing with Gold Coast views; short stop.
objection: A roadside hinterland lookout with no other source.

name: Garage 25
reason: Rule 1-2: one Wikivoyage listing; private car collection of a Bathurst winner; a visit of around an hour; hours unclear.
objection: Niche and possibly bookings only.

name: GC Aqua Park
reason: Rule 2: a commercial inflatable aqua park operator, not a place visitors see; Wikivoyage itself calls it small.
objection: Listed as worth checking out in a Wikivoyage Do entry.

name: Gold Coast Aquatic Centre
reason: Rule 2: a council swimming and sports venue; no visitor draw.
objection: Hosted Commonwealth Games events and a Wikivoyage Do entry.

name: Gold Coast Convention and Exhibition Centre
reason: Rule 2/4: a conference venue; only events, nothing to see.
objection: A listed landmark building.

name: Gold Coast Historical Museum
reason: Rule 1-2: one Wikivoyage See listing for a local history museum; short visit, uncertain opening.
objection: Could be a worthwhile 1 hour stop; thin evidence.

name: Gold Coast Wax Museum

objection: Wax museums are classic tourist stops.

name: Green Mountain Gardens

objection: A maintained botanical garden is a genuine stop for park visitors.

name: Hinze Dam
reason: Rule 1-2: one Wikivoyage Do listing; dam with park, cafe and mountain bike trails.

name: Inflatable World Burleigh
reason: Rule 2: a children's commercial inflatable play venue; Wikivoyage says not the best known.
objection: Open daily for families.

name: Jebbribillum lookout

name: Jellurgal Aboriginal Cultural Centre

name: Landcare's Environmental Park
